capabilities: Render folders as star systems and notes as orbiting planets
Replay vault growth in chronological Genesis
Inspect notes, links, backlinks and mind maps
Show a mini orrery in the sidebar
Export photo cards, posters and sky reports
extras: Desktop only; requires WebGL. Makes no network requests at runtime. Shows a one-time GitHub star prompt after updates. Browser demo available.
problem: Obsidian's graph view does not show folder structure as systems or replay the order in which notes were written.
summary: 3D galaxy graph that draws folders as star systems and notes as orbiting planets, with history replay, link maps and offline rendering.
